tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ āryā mā rī tsyai sā ngha naṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal la/ /gang gis ming tsam dran pas kyang*/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar byed ma/ /'odazer can la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi bsgrub pa'i rim pa bshad | | rang gi snying ga'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni/ /mam̐ gyi yi ge bsam par bya/ /de yi 'od zer snang ba yis/ /bde gshegs sras bcas spyan drangs la/ /yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro bas/ / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya/ /kun tu stong par bsams nas ni// mam̐ gyi yi ge gyur pa las/ /rin chen las grub shing rta'i dbyibs/ /phag gis drangs pa'i steng du ni/ /sna tshogs padma'i lte ba la/ /'phags ma gser gyi mdog lta bu/ /g.yas brkyang skyil krung tshul gyis gnas/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon pa yis/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin cing*/ /g.yas pa mchog sbyin phyag rgya can/ /zhi dang 'dzum dang sgeg pa'i tshul/ /lang tsho la bab lus rgyas pa/ /rin po che yi rgyan gyis spras/ /dar gyi na bzas rab tu g.yogs | | de yi gnas gsum byin brlabs nas/ /ye shes 'khor los brtan par bya/ /dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag po ni/ /rnam snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa'o/ /de yi thugs kar zla ba yi/ /dbus su mam̐ gyi yi ge la// sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsam/ /oṃ mā rī tsyai mam̐ swā hā/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzlas/ /gal te skyo bar gyur na des/ /nyi ma zla bar mngon phyogs te/ /de yi mdun gnas bcom ldan ma/ /mchod nas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir/ /'di yi gzungs ni bklag bya zhing*/ /gtor ma yis kyang mnyes byas la/ /'dod don gsol ba gdab par bya/ /phyir bzlog pa dang 'khrul 'khor dang*/ /bum pa'i cho ga gzhan du gsal/ /bkra shis pa dang tshe ring zhing*/ /'dod don gang de 'grub par 'gyur/

/dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i gsung*/ /rin chen grags pa las brgyud pa/ /bla ma'i zhal las rnyed pa 'di/ /blo dman gzhan la phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis kun tu gsal bar byas/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba des/ /phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi | | bar du gcod pa kun bsal nas/ /thub pa'i 'byor pa thob par shog/ tshul 'di blo gros thogs med pa/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa po/ /lus can kun gyi dge legs dpal/ /bdag gi bla ma bzang pos mdzad/ / gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*/ /'jigs pa kun la rab tu skyob byed cing*/ /dri med bde ba nye bar stsol mdzad ma/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// // ༄༅/ /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅ / /lha mo 'od zer can sgrub pa'i thabs/ rje btsun ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrin las 'od kyis gdul bya yi/ /dpal yon me tog rgyas mdzad pa/ /'od zer can la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /de la lha mo 'od zer can bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gi 'dug la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum du skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyams pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ chags pa dang sdang ba med cing 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'i btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya | de yi ched du rje btsun ma 'od zer can bsgoms snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā ba shungnghaḥsarba ngharmaḥswa wa bhā ba shungngho3 ham̐/ zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong par bsam

| stong pa'i ngang las bhrū ྃ las rin po che las grub pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten chen po'i bum pa'i nang du pam̐ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs par bsams pa'i thugs kar rang gi shes pa mam̐ las mya ngan med pa'i shing mam̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i gser gyi shing rta'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can/ shin tu mdzes pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsams pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying gi nang du mam̐ ser po bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor bar spyan drangs/ oṃ mā rī tsyai sarba buddha bo dhi sa twā ya/ argham̐ pra tītstsha (《 zha 》+ ye ) swā hā la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mā rī tsyai sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes (《 zha 》+ brjod pas ) rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs snga ma bzhin mchod nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol btab pas/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de la sems gtad de yid mnyam par bzhag sngags bzla bar 'dod na snying ga'i nang gi mam̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba bskor las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ oṃ mā rī tsyai maṃ swā hā/ zhes yang snying ci nus pa bzla'o/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bdun cu ste/ de snyed bzlas na las rnams 'grub par 'gyur bar 'gyur ba nyid do/ /gzhan yang tadya thā/ oṃ pa ra pra ma si la sogs pa rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ ba ta li la sogs pa'i snying po'i sngags dang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ ā lo tā lo la sogs pa'i las kyi sngags rnams gang mos pa la ci nus pa bzla bar bya'o/ /bzlas pa tshar ba dang rang la bstim pa'i ye shes pa phyung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs pa la mchod pas mchod nas bzod par gsol te/ oṃ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol la/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyad do/ /'di'i mdo 'don par 'dod na/ thog mar nyi ma dang zla ba gang shar ba'i phyogs su phyogs te/ der 'od zer can ma mngon sum ltar dmigs pa la mchod cing bstod nas gsol gdab pa'i phyir gzungs bton pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag g.yas pa brkyang ba/ bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal nas byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ 'di'i mdo ji tsam nus pa gdon par bya'o/ /mthar yang mchod cing bstod nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo'o/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ dkar gtor bshams pa sbyangs la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs | stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por

∶ bskyed la (《 zha 》 gyur ) / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgyas/ gtor ma phul ba gsol nas byin gyis brlab par bsam zhing*/ tadya thā/ oṃ ba ta li ba da li ba ra li ba ra ha mu khi sarba duṣtāṃ pra duṣtā nāṃ tsakṣu rmu khaṃ bandha bandha dzambha ya/ stambha ya/ mo ha ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul nas/ arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod la/ gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*/ / 'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing*/ /dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phag bdun gyis drangs rin chen shing rta'i khrir/ /padma zla ba'i gdan la bder bzhugs shing | | zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs pa/ /bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag g.yas gdul bya rnams la mchog stsol zhing*/ /g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dgyes rgur spyod/ /bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis/ /rnam par brgyan pas chos tshul kun sgrogs shing*/ /sngags tshul du mas dngos grub kun stsol ba/ /chos sngags yi ger 'phrul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdod nas rnam dag spros pa nyer zhi yang*/ /mkhyen dang brtse bas kun nas rab rtsen zhing | | gdul bya'i yid la sna tshogs kun 'jug pa'i/ /ye shes lnga yi thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis khyod sku dran zhing sngags bzlas te// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyis/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /srid zhi'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ / zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas oṃ badzra muḥzhes brjod pas/ bdag la 'dod pa'i don thams cad gnang nas gshegs par bsam mo// tshul 'di la rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na/

gnas skabs su bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub par 'gyur ro | | 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /byas pa'i bsod nams 'od zer gyis/ /'od zer can du bdag gyur nas/ /'gro ba'i snang ba byed par shog | 'di'i brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ sangs rgyas dze tā ri pa/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal rdo rje gdan pa/ ngharma shrī/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ chos rje sa skya pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun chen po/ chos kyi rje paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rnams so | | mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs 'di ni rang gi slob ma lo tsā ba sam̐ gha zhes bya bas bskul ba'i don du/ 'phags pas sa mo yos bu'i lo/ dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu gcig la/ chu mig dpal gyi sde chen du sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni a ma la shrī'o// // ༄༅/ /'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'phags ma 'od zer can bsgrub par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de yi ched du 'od zer can ma bsgoms snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā ba'i sngags kyis bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du padma dang zla ba'i steng du/ bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa dang sems can smin par byas/ slar 'dus nas gcig tu 'dres pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i thugs kar rang gi shes pa mam̐ las mya ngan med pa'i shing mam̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i gser gyi shing rta'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas pa mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can shin tu mdzes pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsams pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsam/ snying gi nang du mam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyis gnas nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ mā rī tsyai argham̐ pra tītstsha swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mā rī tsyai sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs/ snga ma bzhin du mchod nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de la sems gtad de mnyam par bzhag go /sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ snying gi nang gi mam̐ gyi mtha' ma sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas rang byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing gzungs nas 'byung ba'i sngags rnams dang*/ oṃ mā rī tsyai mam̐ swā hā/ zhes yang snying ci nus pa bzla'o/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bdun cu'o// bzlas pa tshar ba dang rang la bstim pa'i ye shes pa phyung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs te/ mchod pas mchod nas bzod par gsol zhing oṃ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol te/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyad do/ / gzungs 'don par 'dod na/ thog mar nyi ma dang zla ba shar ba'i phyogs su phyogs te/ der 'od zer can ma mngon sum ltar dmigs pa la/

mchod nas gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir gzungs bton pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag g.yas pa brkyang ba bdag gi spyi bor bzhag nas/ byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing gzungs 'don no/ /mthar yang mchod cing bstod nas dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo/ gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas dkar gtor bshams pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing che ba'i nang du ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bskyed nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun du spyan drangs/ de la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ tadya thā oṃ ba ta li/ ba da li/ ba ra li | ba ra ha mu khi/ sarba duṣtān/ pra duṣtā nām̐/ tsakṣu rmu kham̐/ bandha bandha/ bandha mu kham̐

| dzambha ya/ stambha ya/ mo ha ya/ i dam̐ ba liṃ/ gṛhṇā pa ya/ gṛhnā pa ya swā hā/ zhes sngags bdun gyis phul nas/ argham̐ la sogs pas mchod la/ gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*/ /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing*/ /dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phag bdun gyis drangs rin chen shing rta'i khrir/ / padma zla ba'i gdan la bder bzhugs shing*/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs pa/ /bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo | | phyag g.yas gdul bya rnams la mchog stsol zhing*/ /g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin la/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes shing dgyes rgur skyod | | bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis khyod sku dran zhing sngags bzlas te/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyis | | bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /chos bzhin bsam pa 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa rnams kyis bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas 'dod pa'i don thams cad gnang nas rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo/ /tshul 'di la rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'od zer can ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ /skad gnyis smra ba du lag gis/ /gsol ba btab nas 'phags pas sbyar/ /dge des kun mkhyen thob par shog /lcags mo lug gi lo/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin mo shing kun gyi sa char sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /sbyin sreg bzhugs/ / ༄༅ / /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga rje btsun ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phrin las dge ba'i 'od zer gyis/ / 'gro ba bde la legs 'god pa/ /'od zer can la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sbyin sreg cho ga bshad/ /lha mo 'od zer can gyi bsnyen pa sngon du song bas | sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/

nad dang sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i don du | zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs dben par/ thab khung dkar po/ rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru phyed/ kha khyer sor bzhi bkyed nas/ sor bzhi'i 'phangs su brtsigs pa'i mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la mya ngan med pa'i shing bri bar bya'o/ /der dri zhim zhing kha dog dkar po'i bud shing brtsigs pa'i g.yas su/ yam shing*/ mar/ til/ zas mchog 'bras | so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūr ba/ ku sha rnams rim pa bzhin dgod pa ni/ bsreg rdzas dang*/ g.yon du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ dkar gtor gnyis bsham mo/ /de nas rang nyid shar du phyogs te 'dug pa'i mdun du/ rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs pas bsngags pa'i dri'i chu bzhag go /sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ bdag nyid la mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ thab dang bsreg rdzas/ mchod rdzas rnams la dri'i chus gtor zhing*/ a mṛ tas ma dag pa bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shungnghaḥsarba dharmāḥ swa bhā wa bi shungngho3 ham̐/ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rin po che dkar po las grub pa'i thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan par bud shing gi rtsig pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par bskyed nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ mchod rdzas dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba nus pa phun gsum tshogs pa dang ldan par bskyed nas/ so so'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i mes/ bud shing la lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐ zhes brjod nas spar ba/ dri'i chu dang a mṛ tas bsang zhing*/

swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las | pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa zhu ba las/ me lha dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ ra skyes dmar po la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa | phyag g.yas pa dbyug gu gsum pa/ g.yon pa bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ ∶ khri snyan sa le'i (《 zha 》 kriṣṇa sa ra'i ) lpags pas stod g.yogs dang*/ mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ zhi zhing dul ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar bskyed pa'i dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas/ rang gi snying ga'i mam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drang bar bsam zhing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya las g.yab pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me lha drang srong 'byung po'i bdag / bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol | | oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi zhes pas spyan drangs la thab kyi shar lhor bzhugs pa la/ oṃ agna ye padma ka ma lā ya st+wam̐ gyi padma'i gdan phul nas/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes kun la sbyar la/ argham̐ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā dyam̐ pra tītstsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ puṣpe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog nghū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ dī pe āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ gandhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ nai wi dye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo phul nas/ me lha'i lce'i rtse mor rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba dgang blugs kyi ram̐ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ agna ye dī pyā dī pya bi shungngha ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang | nad dang bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul lo/

/de nas rang gi snying ga nas/ lcags kyu zhags pa/ lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams spros pas/ me lha dam tshig pa la bstim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ e hye hi agna ye sa pa ri wā ra badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ badzra spho ṭa bam̐/ badzra ghaṇḍe hoḥzhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs | argham̐ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing | bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas da ེ nyid mchod pa dang*/ gnas bsrung ba'i don du ku sha rnams/ oṃ agna ye bdag cag la gegs med par mdzod cigalas kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol | oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad nas dbul lo/ /mchod yon la sogs pas mchod pa rnams gong du brjod pa'i tshul gyis phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang ∶ mchog gi (《 zha 》 mgon gyi ) sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po khro bos dbang bskur zhing*/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod do/ /de nas bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ agna ye | bdag cag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā zhes thog ma dang tha mar spel tshig dang bcas pa dang*/ bar du spel tshig med par grangs nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam re dbul te/ go rim ni bshams pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar ro/ / slar yang sngar ltar mchod cing bstod la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab nas | oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐ṃ zhes brjod nas/

mar gyi blugs gzar gcig blugs pas me lha 'bar ba'i mer gyur par blta'o/ /'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// // de nas me 'bar ba'i dbus su rje btsun ma 'od zer can bdag bskyed ltar bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ 'od zer can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drang par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi mā rī tsyai sarba bungngha bo nghi satwa sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥ hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod nas spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la | oṃ mā rī tsyai arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod cing bstod nas*/ me lha'i skabs ltar lha mo bzhis dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ sgrub thabs ltar dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs pa la/ snga ma ltar byon zan dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ mā rī tsyai agna ye swā hā zhes bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byon zan dbul lo/ /de nas oṃ mā rī tsyai sarba bungngha bo nghi satwā ya zhes kun la sbyar la argham̐ nas shabda'i bar phyi'i mchod pas mchod la/ bstod pa rnams kyis bstod nas/ bsreg rdzas so sor phul bas yam shing gis gzi brjid dang*/ mar gyis tshe 'phel zhing til gyis nad dang bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang*/ zas mchog gis phun gsum tshogs pa 'phel ba dang*/ 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru rnams kyis longs spyod dang dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang*/ dūr bas tshe 'phel ba dang*/ ku shas bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub gnang bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ mā rī tsyai bdag cag gi sdig pa dang | sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shantiṃku ru swā hā zhes thog ma dang tha mar spel tshig dang bcas pa dang*/ bar du spel tshig med pa'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis brgya rtsa gcig la sogs pa dbul lo/ /zhi ba'i ∶ sbyin sreg gi (《 zha 》 bsreg ) rdzas kyi dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ til la bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis stong la sogs pa dbul lo/ /gal te sbod gtong dang*/ byad ltems la sogs pa yod kyis dogs na/ tadya thā/ oṃ ba ta li nas mo ha ya'i bar brjod pa'i mthar | pha rol gyi sbod gtong dang*/ byad stems thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes brjod cing*/ brgya'am stong la sogs pa ci rigs pa dbul lo/ / bar skabs su me gso ba'i phyir/ bud shing bsnan zhing*/ yam shing dang mar yang ci rigs su dbul lo/ /de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams phul ba rdzogs pa'i mthar yang snying spel tshig dang bcas pa'i dgang blugs gsum byon zan gyi skabs ltar dbul lo/ /de nas mchod cing bstod la/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gdon dang phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa (《 zha 》+ thams cad ) dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar gsol ba btab pa ltar gnang bar bsam mo/ /de nas ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol nas | oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/

/sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badzra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ thal ba cung zad rang gi dpral ba/ mgrin pa snying gar bskus nas/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o | | 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ste dngos gzhi'o/ /de nas thab tu mar dgang gzar gang blugs nas/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su me lha sngar bzhin gsal bar dmigs la mchod cing bstod do (《 zha 》+ nas ) / /bsreg rdzas rnams bdun bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa re re sngar ltar phul la/ byon zan gyis skabs ltar dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la | oṃ agna ye i dam̐ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya/ gṛhṇā pa ya/ ma ma sarba pā pam̐ sarba bighnān | sarba u pa dra bya shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la slar yang mchod cing bstod de/ 'das pa'i skabs ltar 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab nas/ bzod par gsol la spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las phyir bkyed de/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /slar yang dus bzhin ci nas byon/ /bdag gi las rnams thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ agha ye badzra muḥzhes brjod pas rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /de nas las kya ི rjes bsdus te/ thal ba rol mo dang bcas pas chu bo chen por dor la | dga' ston la longs spyod cing*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod pa dang | smon lam rgya chen po gdab bo/ /gal te gzhan gyi don du byed par 'dod na/ bsgrub bya de nyid la dmigs shing*/ ming dang spel te bsreg blugs phul bas de'i don 'gyur ba nyid do/ /sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshims | | tshim nas dngos grub rab tu ster/ /gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni dgang*/

/zhes 'byung bas/ sngags kyis nus pa 'byin pa dang*/ byang chub bsgrubs pa dang*/ thun mong gi las bsgrub pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa 'di sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg gi /cho ga bshad pa'i dge ba'i me 'od kyis/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus rnams bsregs nas/ /kun mkhyen ye shes snang ba 'bar bar shog /lha mo 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg 'di ni/ rang gi slob ma lo tsā ba sam̐ gha zhes bya bas bskul ba'i don du/ 'phags pas sa mo yos bu'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu gsum la chu mig dpal gyi sde chen du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' dpal lo// // ༄༅/ /bstod pa rgyas pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅ / /bcom ldan 'das 'od zer can ma'i bstod pa/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od zer dam pa'i 'od mdzad pas// snang ba dam pa'i dpal bskyed pa/ /'od zer can la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de nyid la ni bstod par bgyi/ /bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad dpal gyis/ / gnyis med ye shes 'od zer las/ /kun nas yongs su rnam 'phrul ba/ / 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid gnas nam mkha'i klong dkyil du/ /

yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus/ /ham̐ las sgra gcan 'dzin chen po/ / nyi zla 'dzin pa 'gyel ba'i steng*/ /ram̐ las rin chen shing rta mchog /phag bdun gyi ni drangs pa'i khrir/ /pam̐ las 'dab brgyad padma'i dbus/ /ram̐ skyes nyi ma'i gdan la 'dud/ /de yi steng du oṃ yig las/ /rnam par snang mdzad zla ba'i mdog /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /kun tu zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs kar zla steng sa bon mam̐/ /sngags kyi phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od/ /'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ /'khrungs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gser mdog can/ /zhal gsum phyag brgyad zhal re zhing*/ /spyan gsum 'dzum khro'i tshul can ma/ / g.yon brkyang rol pas bzhugs la 'dud/ /zhal g.yas dmar zhing rjes chags ma/ /g.yon pa phag zhal dbang sngon mdog /rngam zhing khro la drag tu sgrogs | | rgyan rnams kun gyis sgeg la 'dud/ /rdo rje lcags kyu mda' dang khab/ /phyag g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin bsnams/ /g.yon rnams mya ngan med dang gzhu/ /skud pa sdigs mdzub bcas la 'dud/ /lwa ba'i stod g.yogs dmar po dang*/ /sna tshogs dar gyi sham thabs can/ /spyi gtsug rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /rnam par brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ / shar gyi 'dab mar nyi ma'i steng*/ /mam̐ yig sngags bcas las skyes zhing*/ / padma rā ga ltar snang ba'i/ /ba ta li la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi phag gdong ma/ khab dang lcags kyu g.yas pas 'dzin/ /zhags pa mya ngan med pa'i shing*/ /g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lwa dmar am̐ ga rag (《 zha 》《 lu 》 reg ) dang ni/ /stag gi lpags pa'i smad g.yogs can | | sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma rungs pa rnams 'gugs pa dang*/ /gsod pa'i las la rab brtson zhing*/ khyad par klu dang sa bdag rnams/ /'dul bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho yi 'dab mar nyi ma'i steng*/ /mam̐ yig sngags bcas las skyes zhing*/

/gser bzang 'bar ba'i mdog mtshungs pa/ /ba da lī la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rab mdzes ma/ /g.yas pa a shwa ka dang khab/ /g.yon pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang*/ /zhags pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhon nu lang tsho rab rgyas shing*/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' dang*/ /rin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /yid 'phrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la rin chen char 'bebs pas/ /dbul ba'i 'jigs pa rnam sel zhing*/ /gdug can rnams kyi kha mig dang*/ /yan lag 'ching mdzad khyod la 'dud/ /nub kyi 'dab mar nyi ma'i steng*/ /mam̐ yig sngags bcas las skyes zhing*/ /puṇḍa rī ka'i mdog mtshungs ma/ / ∶ ba ra (《 zha 》 battā ) li la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan yangs ma | | phyag g.yas rdo rje dang ni khab/ /zhags pa mya ngan med pa'i shing*/ / g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dar gyi na bza' rab gsol zhing | | rin chen me tog tshogs kyis spras/ /g.yon brkyang ba yi skyil krung gis | | rnam par bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba rnams kyi sdig pa dang | | gnod pa zhi ba'i 'od mdzad cing*/ /gdug pa can rnams rengs mdzad ma/ /lha mo dgyes rgur spyod la 'dud/ /byang gi 'dab mar nyi ma'i steng | | mam̐ yig sngags bcas las skyes zhing*/ /padma'i rā ga'i mdog mtshungs ma/ /ba ra ha mu khi la 'dud/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi phag gdong ma | | spyan gsum phyag g.yas rdo rje mda'/ /zhags pa mya ngan med pa'i shing | | g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stod g.yogs dmar po'i oṃ ga rag /sna tshogs dar gyis sham thabs can/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ khro zhing sgeg pa (《 zha 》 ma ) khyod la 'dud/ /lha dang lha min klu dbang dang*/ /mi dang gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs/ /dbang du sdud cing myos mdzad ma/ /yid 'ong ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i/ /bum bzangs bdud rtsis yongs gang bas/ /padma'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir/

/gnas pa la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo mchog gi rjes 'brangs pa/ /nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan dang*/ /gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad de/ /kun sdud ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs skyong rnams dang lha rnams dang | | rgyal chen bzhi dang gnod sbyin dang*/ /klu dbang rnams dang lha min gyis | | mchod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyan thos rnams dang rang rgyal dang | | sems dpa' rnams kyis bkur bgyis shing*/ /rgyal ba yis kyang bsngags bgyis pa/ /phyag byar 'os pa khyod la 'dud/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas brnyes ma/ khyed la skye 'gag ma mchis slad/ /'gro dang 'ong ba ga la mchis/ /gnas bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de lta mod kyi kun 'gro yi/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs brnyes pas/ /skad cig gcig la'ang yul kun du/ khyab par gshegs pa khyod la 'dud/ /de slad 'di nas khyod byon la/ /'dir ni gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes/ /su zhig gis ni bstan par nus/ /dpag yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'on kyang gnas dus nges pa la/ /mos pa'i 'gro rnams rjes gzung phyir/ /nyi ma zla ba'i mdun nas khyod/ /gshegs par ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de lta mod kyi nyi 'od kyis/ /'byung po'i bya rnams long ba ltar/ khyod kyi 'od kyis rmugs bgyis pa'i/ /'byung pos khyod bltar mi nus na/ /gzung ba dang ni bcing ba dang*/ /dgag pa dang ni brgal ba dang*/ /dbang du bgyi bar smos ci 'tshal | | dbang phyug dam pa khyod la 'dud/ khyod lta zhog gi khyod kyi mtshan | | tshul bzhin 'dzin pa gang lags pa/ /de yang de 'dra nyid mdzad pa'i | | mdzad pa dam pa khyod la 'dud/ /de slad bdag gis khyod kyi mtshan | | 'dzin zhing tshul bzhin mas bgyis kyis/ /bdag kyang de 'drar phyogs kun las/ /rnam par rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang bdag gi gnyen bshes kun/ /lam dang de bzhin lam log dang*/ /skye bos 'jigs dang rgyal rigs kyi/ /'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol | |

de bzhin glang chen chom rkun dang*/ /seng ge stag dang me dang chu// sbrul dang dug dang phyir rgol dang*/ /dgra yi 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ / bdag ni gnas skabs thams cad du/ /ji lta'i tshul gyis gnas kyang rung | | gdon rims 'khrugs pa thams cad las/ /kun nas yongs su bsrung du gsol/ khyod la nye bar bsten pa'i 'bangs/ /bdag cag rnams la 'tshe bgyid pa/ /de dag khyod kyi mngon spyod kyi/ /las kyis gdul bar mdzad du gsol/ /gang dag khyod la skyabs pa dang*/ /gang gzhan khyod la mi 'dud pa/ /de dag mtshungs pa mdzad na ko /gzhan du ji ltar yal bar 'dor | | gdug pa rnams ni tshar gcod dang*/ /nyam thag dbugs 'byin mdzad pa dag /legs par sgrub pa rjes 'dzin pa/ khyod kyi dam bca' ma lags sam/ /gal te las la rag las na/ /las tshul so sor spyad pa'i 'bras | | de des nyams su myong ba la/ khyod kyi phrin las ci zhig 'tshal/ / de slad khyod la skyabs pa dang*/ /skyob pa mchog la gsol ba dang*/ /de yi sngags la 'bad bgyis pa'i/ /ngal ba 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /nor bu dpag bsam shing sogs kyis/ /'gro ba'i re ba rdzogs bgyid na/ khyod ni brtse chen thams cad mkhyen/ /mthu chen mnga' bas smos ci 'tshal/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /dbye dang bskrad dang gsad la sogs/ / bdag gis gang dag don gnyer ba/ /las de dag ni grub par mdzod/ / ral gri mig sman ri lu dang*/ /mi snang ba dang bcud kyis len/ /rkang mgyogs sa 'og gter dang ni/ /bu mo dam pa dgug pa dang*/ /rig 'dzin mkha' la spyod pa dang*/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal rgyas dang*/ / grol dang rnam grol mchog rnams kyi/ /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol// bcom ldan 'od zer can ma la/ /bstod pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun// chos dang phrin las sna tshogs kyis/ /'od mdzad chos kyi rgyal por shog / rgyal po chen po'i pho brang du bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can ma mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas par byed pa'i ched du/

bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di lcags pho rta'i lo/ dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu lnga la/ dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /spyan ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅ / /rgya gar skad du/ lo tsa nā sā ngha naṃ/ bod skad du/ spyan ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po thog mar rnal 'byor pas kha dang gdong la sogs pa dag par bkrus nas/ chos bdag med pa dran par byas la/ snying rje chen pos brlan pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ snying gar lam̐ gyi yi ge las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi snang bas/ lha mo spyan sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang lhan cig pa spyan drangs la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ / de nas sā bhā wa'i sngags kyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms nas/ slar yang padma dang zla ba'i steng du bsgom par bya ba'i tshul ni/ lam̐ gyi yig 'brus bsgrubs pa ste/ /rgyal ba thams cad kyis kyang brgyan/ /lha mo spyan gsum phyag brgyad ma/ /zhal gsum gser gyi mdog dang mtshungs/ /sgeg mo'i cha lugs legs 'chang ma/ /cung zad bzhad dang 'dod chen ma/ /dang po'i phyag ni mchog sbyin mdzad/ /de bzhin gnyis pa mi 'jigs sbyin/ / phyag gsum pa ni rdo rje ste/ /bzhi pa yis ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pas sdigs 'dzub zhags pa can/ /rin chen nyi ma gnyis pa na/ /gsum pa na ni bgrang phreng ste/ /bzhi pa gzhu yis rnam par brgyan/ /'od 'bar 'od zer phreng ba can/ /lha rnams 'jigs pas sems myos te/ /lag pas thal mo sbyar bar byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprin 'phro ba/ /ye shes rdo rje spyan ma bsam/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas klubs/ /byang chub yan lag 'bras bus brgyan/ /sems can kun la gzigs pa mo/ /lha mo 'di 'dra bsgom par bya/

/de nas de'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang ro gcig par byas te/ dbang bskur nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par blta'o/ /de nas thal mo khong stong du sbyar nas mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse bkug pa mthe bong gnyis la sbyar ba mig gi tshul du byas pa 'dis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas rab tu brtan par bya'o/ /de nas 'd-i'i gsang sngags bzla ba'i phyir/ snying gar zla ba kha sbyar ba'i nang du son pa'i lam̐ gyi yi ge las 'od zer srad bu'i rnam pa'i sngags byung nas/ yongs su dkris par bsam zhing*/ oṃ bha ga wa tī ru ru sphu ru/ dzwā la tiṣṭhā singngha lo tsa nī/ sarba artha sā ngha na ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags ci nus pa'i bzlas brjaud bya'o/ /gsang sngags 'di ni bzlas tsam gyis/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams dgyes/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams 'dar 'gyur te | | sangs rgyas rdo rdo rjes dran byed/ /zhi ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum/ / rdo rje dam tshig gis bskul nas/ /shi ba rnams la srog sbyin mdzad/ /ma grub rnams la grub pa stsol/ /bla med rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /sems can kun la legs gzigs ma/ /spyan gyi sgrub thabs byas pa yis/ /'gro bas ye shes spyan thob shog /bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas spyan phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs 'di ni 'phags pas sa pho rta'i lo/ dbyu gu'i zla ba la sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rje btsun ma gza' rnams kyi yum bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du yum chen po bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cigasdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig

bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig phan tshun chags pa dang sdang ba med cing mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs par gyur cig snyam du tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shungnghaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shungngho3 ham̐ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros/ sems can gyis don byas/ slar 'dus nas rdo rje la thim zhing de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma gza'i yum du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas sngo zhing cung zad khro ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas rdo rje/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas padma/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas klubs pa/ sku las 'od zair dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bkod nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas yum chen mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor bar spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spyan drang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas | sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ dri ma thams cad dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang*/

gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi dbang thams cad thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de lta bu'i lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de sems mnyam par bzhagasngags zlo bar 'dod na snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis rang gi sdig pa/ sgrib pa/ nad dang bar du gcod pa rnams sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi ye shes dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam pas rang la bstim/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ gdon dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi gdug pa'i sems zhi bar byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bedyai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tyaiai swā hā/ zhes nye snying gang mos la ci nus su bzlas so/ / bzlas pa tshar ba dang oṃ sarba bidyā badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol | rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyad do/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas dkar gtor sbyangs pa/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ zhes rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas ma dag pa bsang*/ oṃ badzra dzwā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra na hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces rdo rje'i me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ rin po'i che'i snod lha'i bdud rtsi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pas gang bar bskyed/ oṃ a kā ro mu kham̐ sarba ngharmā ṇām̐/ ādya nutpanna twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā | zhes rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas gtor ma'i mgron rnams kyis bzhed pa'i don thams cad 'byung bar bsam/ de nas rang skad cig gis yum chen mor mos pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas yum chen mo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang | gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs rnams thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba bidya sarba bungngha bo nghi satwā nām̐/ sarba gra ha nakṣa tra sarba bhū te bhya: idam̐ ba li ྃgṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ dngos grub ma lus pa gnang bar bsam/ de nas de dag gi rgyud bskul ba'i phyir/ yum gyi mdo 'don pa la sogs pa bya/ mthar bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol/ cho ga rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gza' rnams kyi yum gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdor bsdus pa/ las dang po pa rnams kyi don du/ 'phags pas me pho byi ba'i lo khra'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu gsum la thang skyar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// // ༄༅/ /sngags kyi dag byed bzhugs/ / ༄༅ / /na mo bungnghā ya/ na mo badzra ngha rā ya/ na maྉྤdma dha rā ya/ na maྈྐ mā rā ya/ na mo gra hā ṇām̐ sarbā sha pa ri pu ra kā nām̐/ na mo nakṣa tra ṇam̐/ na mo dwā da sha rā shi nam̐/ tadya thā/ oṃ bungnghe bungnghe/ badzre badzre/ padme padme/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sma ra sma ra/ krī ḍā ya kṝ ḍā ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya | marda ya marda ya/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba bi ghnān/ ku ru ku ru ma ma kāryam̐ | tshindha tshindha/

sarba du ṣtām̐/ kṣa pa ya kṣa pa ya/ shānte shānte/ dānte dānte/ dā pa ya dā pa ya swā hā/ dru ta nā darshā ya/ ādmā nām̐ rakṣa rakṣa mām̐ sarba satwāshtsa/ sarba gra ha naksha tra/ bi nghānsa ri brtā ya/ bha ga wa tī ma hā ma ye pra sā ngha ya/ sarba duṣtām̐/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ngha ya sho ngha ya/ sarba pā pam̐/ badzre badzre/ tsand+re tsand+re/ tsand+ri ni tsand+ri ni tsand+ri ni/ tu ru tu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mu yu mu yu/ muñtsa muñtsa/ ha bā ha bo/ u gre u gra ta pe/ pu ra ya pu ra ya/ bha ga wa tī ma no ra tham̐ ma ma sa pa ri wā ra sya sarba satwā nāñtsa/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a nghiṣṭhī na/ a nghiṣṭhī te sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ hūm̐ swā hā/ hrīḥ swā hā/ nghrum̐ swā hā/ nghri ྃswā hā/ padma ngha rā ya swā hā/ oṃ a di tyā ya swā hā/ oṃ sau mā ya swā hā/ oṃ ngha ra ni su tā ya swā hā/ oṃ bu nghā ya swā hā/ oṃ bṛ haspa ta yai swā hā/ oṃ shu krā ya swā hā/ oṃ kṛṣṇa warṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ rī ha be swā hā/ oṃ ke ta be swā hā/ oṃ bu nghā ya swā hā/ oṃ badzra ngha rā ya swā hā/ oṃ padma ngha rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku mā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ sarba gra he bhyaḥswā hā/ oṃ sarba nakṣa tre bhyaḥswā hā/ oṃ sarba dwa da sha rā shi bhyaḥswā hā/ oṃ sarbo pa dra be bhyaḥswā hā/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tyai swā hā/ oṃ sarba bidyā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā// //oṃ me gholkā ya swā hā/ oṃ shi tām̐ sha be swā hā/ oṃ raktāṃ ga ku mā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ bu dha ya swā hā/ oṃ bṛ haspa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ a su rotta mā ya swā hā/ oṃ kṛṣṇa warṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā ya swā hā/ oṃ dzyo ti ke ta be swā hā/ oṃ buu nghā ya swā hā/ oṃ badzra ngha rā ya swā hā/ oṃ padma ngha rā ya swā hā | oṃ ku mā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ nghri ta rāṣtā ya swā hā/ oṃ bi ru ṭa kā ya swā hā/

oṃ bi rū pakṣā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya swā hā/ 'phags pas rgya dpe la dag par gtugs so// // ༄༅/ /∶'dod lha'i (《 zha 》 yi dam gyi lha rnams la )bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las bskyed pa'i sras/ /byang chub spyod pa bla med mthar phyin pas/ /shākya'i rgyal po'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur pa | | mgon po ma pham pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi rje/ / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus dpyis 'byin pa/ /thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse bas thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid kyi sku/ /drang srong chen po'i tshul du bstan nas kyang*/ /'gro ba'i gdung ba drag po sel mdzad pa | | bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba nyid kyang thugs rje'i dbang gis na/ /lha mo'i tshul ston kun nas gsal ba'i sku/ /yid bzhin nor bu padma legs bsnams pa/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma la phyag 'tshal | | lha dang klu dbang grub pa'i cod pan gyi/ /rinachen 'od zer 'phros pas gang gi zhabs/ /kun tu gsal bas nyi ma'ang zil gnon pa/ / phongs pa kun skyob sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /brtse bas rjes chags padma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ / mda' gzhu utpal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro ba 'jigs pas nyen pa bskyab pa'i phyir/ /brtse bas 'jigs byed khro mo'i skur bstan nas/ /dbugs 'byin mdzad cing dngos grub mchog rtsol ba/ /sgrol ma drag po 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ba/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs nyi ma lta bur gsal/ / nyon mongs dug 'joms rma bya'i mjug sgro dang*/

/dngos grub kun stsol bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin/ /rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*/ /bar du gcod pa kun las grol 'gyur zhing*/ /dri med bde ba chen po thob mdzad pa/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra nī la'i mdog / zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku/ /ye shes ral gri rdo rje'i zhags pa bsnams/ khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dpal chen ∶ nam mkha'i (《 zha 》《 lu 》 ston kha'i ) mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing*// dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ gis 'brug stong chem/ /'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa/ /phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes las/ /nye bar bsgrubs pa'i mthu stobs rdo rje yis | | bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms byed pa/ /dpal chen rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir rab khros pa/ /byu ru'i mdog mtshungs padma'i dbyug to 'dzin/ /rta mchog zhal gyi sgra yis bdud 'joms pa/ khro rgyal rta mgrin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo | | rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs byung zhing*/ /sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba/ /lha mo dbyangs can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'byung lnga'i mdog can 'byung chen lnga la dbang | | kun tu sgyur (《 lu 》 'phrog ) byed rdo rje'i 'dab gshog can/ /klu yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal gyur pa/ /rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo | | gang gis 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal/ /nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du/ /bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs bsrung ba | | rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas/ /sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa/

/nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dod pa'i lha rnams la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /rig ma bcu drug gi ∶mchod pa'i tshig tshan (《 zha 》 tshigs bcad )gnyis bzhugs/ ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru badzra nghā rā ya/ rdo rje lha mo pi wam̐ ma/ /ston ka'i mdog can pi wam̐ lag /pi wam̐ sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo gling bu ma/ /gser gyi mdog can gling bu'i lag /gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo rnga zlum mo/ /bandhu'i mdog can rnga bzlum lag | rnga zlum sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi | | rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga mo/ /ma rgad mdog mtshungs rdza rnga'i lag /rdza rnga'i sgra dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo bzhad pa mo/ /ke ྃshu'i mdog mtshungs bzhad pa'i zhal/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin dang dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo sgeg pa mo/ /dbang sngon mdog mtshungs sgeg pa'i tshul/ /snyems pa'i lus dang glur ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo glu dbyangs ma/ /'char ka'i mdog mtshungs glu len brtson/ /glu dang rol mo'i sgra ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo gar mkhan ma/ /ma rgad mdog mtshungs gar sgyur zhing*/ /gar dang snyan pa'i dbyangs ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo me tog ma/ /gur gum mdog mtshungs me tog lag /me tog char dang rol mo bcas | | nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo bdug spos ma | | du ba'i mdog mtshungs bdug spos lag /bdug pa'i sprin dang rol mor bcas/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo mar me ma | | glog 'od mdog mtshungs mar me'i lag /mar me'i 'od dang rol mor bcas/

/nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo dri chab ma | | pṛ yang mdog mtshungs dung chos lag /dri yi char dang rol mor bcas | | nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo gzugs mdzes ma/ /ston zla'i mdog mtshungs me long lag /yid 'ong gzugs dang rgyan ldan pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo zhal zas ma/ /dzā ba'i mdog mtshungs zhal zas lag /zhal zas bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pa/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo na bza' ma/ /ma rgad mdog mtshungs na bza'i lag /gos dang reg dang 'khyud par ldan/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /rdo rje lha mo chos dbyings ma/ /kunda'i mdog mtshungs chos 'byung lag /zag pa med pa'i bde ster ma/ /nam mkha' khyab pas mchod par bgyi/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /rdo rje lha mo'i mchod pa yis/ /mchod pas dpal bde'i 'bras 'byin pa'i/ /tshul 'di rgyal pos bskul nas sbyar/ /tshig 'di 'phags pas bsdebs mod kyi/ /don 'di 'phags mchog gsung las 'byung*/ /'di yis dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /'di 'dra'i tshul gyis rol par shog /chu phag 'byung ba'i 'khor lo la/ kha'i phing hur bris pa yin// // (《 lu 》+ ༄༅/ /rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa chu glang ma/ / ) ༄༅/ /na mo badzra satwā ya/ hūm̐ gis yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ / rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu pi waṃ lag /mkha' mdog nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gis yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu gling bu'i lag / gser mdog nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu rnga zlum lag /ches dmar nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ / bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gis yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/

/rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu rdza rnga'i lag /mdog ljang nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig | hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu bzhad pa'i zhal/ /ches dmar nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu snyaims pa'i lag /mkha' mdog nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu glu len ma/ /gser mdog nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu gar mkhan ma/ /rab ljang nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ / bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu me tog lag /gser mdog nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig/hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu bdug spos lag | ljang ser nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu mar me'i lag /mdog dmar nam mkha' khyab par spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu dri chab lag /mdog ljang nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig | hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu me long lag | mdog dkar nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig

/hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu zhal zas lag /mdog dmar nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu ∶ na bza'i (《 zha 》 nam mkha'i ) lag /mdog ljang nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo/ /rab mdzes rdo rje dril bu chos 'byung lag /mdog dkar nam mkha' khyab par rab spros pa'i/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /rdo rje gsum mchog go 'phang rab brnyes nas/ /'dod yon rdo rje'i bde la dbang 'byor pa/ /nyid kyis nyid la mchod pa'i tshul ji bzhin/ /gang gis mchod pa de yang de 'drar 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad pa bdag gis bsdebs kyang don | | rgyud las 'byung phyir 'gal ba yod ma yin/ /bdag gzhan bde chen rol pas rol pa yi/ /brtul zhugs mchog la dgyes pa'i ngang tshul can | | mi yi dbang po'i gsung gis rab bskul nas/ /sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar ba yin/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba ma lus kun// 'dod yon rdo rje'i bde la rol par shog

/chu mo glang gi lo gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu bdun la kha'i phing hur sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /bsrung ba lnga'i dbang mchog sdom ring thung bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ /sngon 'gro sbyangs nas mtshams gcod bya/ /gnas dang mchod pa byin phab nas/ /bdag bskyed mchod nas bzlas pa bya/ /bum pa gsal gdab mchod nas bzla/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas byin gyis brlab/ /mchod bstod gtor ma rnam bdun btang | | gtso mo'i bum steng mchod rten ni/ /ming byang bcas la kunda dang | | dūr ba sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ /phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma phyogs nas btang*/ /so so'i gtor bcas lha gzhan la/ /gsol ba btab nas slar yang mchod/ /byur bsal dug dbyung rnam gnyis bya/ /rgyal bar byed pas bslangs nas ni/ /gos gsar rgyan gyis brgyan byas nas/ / dbang bskur don du gsol ba gdab/ /spyi bor bum bzhag sor 'brang gi/ gzungs ring gnyis dang sngags gzhan gyis/ /dbang bskur nas ni sngags kyis bsrung*/ /srung 'khor btags shing rdo rje bsrung*/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung byas nas/ /sman nam zas la bden pa'i stobs/ /brjod nas mnga' dbul shis pa brjod/ /yon blang mchod bstod gshegs su gsol// dam pas bskul nas 'phags pas sbyar// // (《 lu 》+ ༄༅/ /bsrung ba lnga'i chog khrigs dang de'i sdom/ / ) ༄༅/ /rje btsun ma rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas rigs sngags 'chang ba rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ 'di cho ga'i rim pa brjod par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa dang*/ yo byad thams cad nye bar bshams nas/ rang nyid 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ gnas dang yo byad byin phab la/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma byin la/ mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ gtso mo 'ba' zhig gis bdag bskyed bsgoms nas mchod pa de'i sngags bzla'o

| | de nas bum pa lnga yod na/ dbus kyi ni shar du bzhag la/ gzhan rnams ni phyogs phyogs na bkod nas/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i rin po che'i bum pa bskyed pa'i nang du sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba bzhin lha mo lnga bskyed par bya ste/ gtso mo'i 'khor du 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ rgyal po bzhi bsgom par bya'o/ /de dag la so so'i ye shes pa bstim nas/ dbang bskur la lha mo lnga'i rigs bdag ni sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /'jig rten pa rnams la ni gtso mo nyid kyis dbur rgyan par bsgom mo/ /de dag la mchod cing bstod nas/ so so'i bzlas pa ci nus byas pa'i mthar mchod cing bstod la/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas | dung chos kyi chu blugs pa'i rkyen gyis/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur blta'o/ /de nas sta gon gyi skabs su me tog tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ dngos gzhi'i tshe rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsang zhing sbyangs pas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la so so'i sngags bdun bdun brjod la byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas mchod yon nas gos zung gi bar du phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ sgeg mo la sogs pa dang*/ rin chen sna bdun dang | 'dod yon lnga ste yid las byung bas mchod nas bstod la/ sta gon gyi tshe/ che ge zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das nas/ rig pa'i rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa la sogs pas mkhyen par gsol nas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /de nas gtor ma rnams phul nas/ bkra shis dang bden pa'i stobs rnams brjod nas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod nas/ ye shes pa nam mkha' la bteg nas dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /dngos gzhi'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ mchod bstod kyi bar snga ma ltar byas la/ gtor ma dang po ni rang rang gi sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i a kā ros lha mo lnga la dbul lo/ /gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa cha gsum nas 'byung ba ltar phyogs skyong rnams la dbul lo/

/de nas gtso mo'i bum pa'i steng du/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten bzhugs pa la/ bsgrub bya'i ming byang btags nas/ mchod rten bcom ldan 'das ma'i dbu thog gi mchod rten du dmigs shing*/ bum pa'i nang du lha mo gzhan dang*/ 'khor thams cad tshang bar dmigs la/ me tog dkar po'am/ legs par bkrus pa'i 'bras dkar po bsangs shing sbyangs pa/ kum̐ las byung ba'i kunda'i phung po nad dang bar chad ma lus par sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bskyed pa/ lha rnams kyi gtsug tor la phul bas/ yon gyi bdag po'i sdig pa dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal bar bsam zhing*/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang nad dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes re re la'ang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa dbul lo/ /de nas dūr ba'i myu gu ma nyams pa bsangs shing sbyangs pa/ dūm̐ las byung ba'i dūr ba gzhon nu tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bskyed de/ snga ma ltar phul bas/ yon gyi bdag po'i tshe dang bsod nams spel bar bsam zhing*/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ che ge mo'i tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad puṣtiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes re re la'ang brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pas dbul lo/ /de nas shar nas brtsams te/ phyogs bzhir gtor ma phyogs bzhi dang*/ dbus kyi gtor ma shar nas btang zhing*/ de dag gi tshe yon gyi bdag pos spos dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de dag gi mthar rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de nas gza' dang skar ma rnams la gtor ma phul la/ gsol ba gdab bo/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa'i gtor ma bdun rim gyis phul nas/ gral la bshams pa'i gtor ma bzhi pa cha gsum gyi cho gas/ 'byung po'i tshogs dang*/ lnga pa klu rnams dang*/ drug pa gzhi'i bdag po dang*/ bdun pa cha gsum gyi cho gas bgegs rnams la bsngos la de nyid ∶ du (《 lu

》 de nyid bsngos tshar ma thag tu ) gtang ngo*/ /de nas yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du yon gyi bdag po bzhag la/ byur gsal ba dang dug bsal ba rigs gnyis byas nas/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje bzung ba'i rtse mo bsgrub bya'i lag pa gnyis kyis bzung la rgyal bar byed pa'i tshig brjod cing*/ dza ya dza ya zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bslangs la khri stan gsar pa'i steng du bzhag go /de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇḍal dang me tog phul la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor la dbang bskur ba'i don du (《 zha 》+ lan gsum ) gsol ba btab nas/ gtso mo'i bum par chu rnams bsdus la spyi bor bzhag pa'i ∶ nang du gsal bar dmigs (《 zha 》 lha rnams bsam ) nas/ de dag gi sku'i cha nas bdud rtsi rgyun babs nas/ bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas bsrung ba'i gzungs snga ma dang phyi ma gnyis skad gdangs mthon pos lan gsum bklag par bya'o/ /de dag gi tshe yon gyi bdag po'i ming spel ba ni shin tu gal che ba nyid do/ /de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la so so'i sngags kyi mthar che ge mo la rakṣa rakṣa rakṣam̐ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bsrung*/ de nas grogs dang bcas pas (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ thams cad kyi ) mgrin gcig tu bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis zhes pa la sogs pa bden pa'i tshig lan gsum dang*/ 'jig rten 'di'am yang (《 zha 》 gang ) dag 'das pa dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshig rnams brjod nas | slar yang (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ dkyil 'khor la ) mchod cing bstod la/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa de nyid du bzhugs par bsam mo | | de lta bu nyi ma gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs pa byas pa'i mthar rgya cher mchod cing bstod nas/ 'dod pa'i don gsol btab la/ smon lam rnam par dag pa btab nas bzod par gsol te/

ye shes pa bshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /de nas las kyi rjes bsdus la/ yon gyi bdag pos slob dpon la yon rgya cher dbul zhing dga' ston rgya cher bya'o/ /'di ma gtogs pa khams gsum na/ /bsrung ba'i rigs sngags gzhan med ces/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis ni/ / nges par gsungs pa de bzhin du/ /'di ma gtogs pa 'dzam gling na/ /cho ga rnam par sbyar ba med/ /de 'dra gzhung gi dgongs don dang*/ /dpal ldan sa skyar rim byon pa'i/ /bla ma'i man ngag las rtogs nas/ /rtogs pa ji bzhin rnam par bkod/ /'di las rnam par phye ba yi/ /cho ga zhib mo gzhan yod mod/ /cho ga'i gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir/ /'di tsam zhig ni bris pa yin/ /de las dge ba gang bskrun pa/ /de yis bdag dang 'gro kun gyis | | de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal yon kun/ /de bzhin gshegs bzhin thob par shog /mdo sde rin po che lnga dang*/ dpal sa skya'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi man ngag la brten nas/ rig sngags 'chang ba dge slong 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ don du gnyer ba'i rang gi slob ma mang pos gsol btab pa'i ngor/ shing mo phag gi lo gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu nyin par | ldan ∶ klong thang (《 zha 》 glen haṃ ) 'jig rten sgron ma'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o/ /yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// //cho ga 'di rnams kyi yi ge gang rung rung la ma sbyin zhes bka' rgya mdzad cing*/ zhu ba yang lan mang du ma byas par mi gnang bar snang ngo*/ /de nas don du gnyer ba'i rang gi grub mtha' 'dzin pa la sbyin par bya'o// // ༄༅/ /bsrung pa lnga'i ∶mtshams gcod (《 lu 》 sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'i bka' sgo )bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /gnas dang yo byad byin phab nas/ rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/

/sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa bdun po dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs par rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo | | de dag la phyag 'tshal nas/ cho ga 'di la sbyar bar bya'o/ /ming 'di zhes bya ba la rigs sngags 'di grub par gyur cig 'byung po'i tshogs gang su dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang*/ nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams dang*/ chu la rgyu ba rnams dang*/ lha rnams dang*/ klu rnams dang*/ lha ma yin rnams dang / (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ rlung lha rnams dang*/ ) nam mkha' lding rnams dang*/ dri za rnams dang*/ mi'am ci rnams dang*/ lto 'phye chen po rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin rnams dang*/ srin po rnams dang*/ yi dwags rnams dang*/ sha za rnams dang*/ 'byung po rnams dang*/ grul bum rnams dang*/ srul po rnams dang*/ lus srul po rnams dang*/ skems byed rnams dang*/ smyo byed rnams dang*/ grib gnon rnams dang*/ brjed byed rnams dang*/ gnon po rnams bdag la nyon ciga'abyung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ zas su mngal za ba rnams dang*/ zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang*/ zas su zhag za ba rnams dang | zas su sha za ba rnams dang*/ zas su tshil za ba rnams dang*/ zas su rkang za ba rnams dang*/ zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang*/ (《 zha 》+ zas su ) srog 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang*/ zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang*/ zas su dri za ba rnams dang*/ zas su bdug pa za ba rnams dang*/ zas su me tog za ba rnams dang*/ zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang*/

zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang*/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang*/ zas su rnag 'thung ba rnams dang*/ zas su phyi sa za ba rnams dang | zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang*/ zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang | zas su mchil ma za ba rnams dang*/ zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang | zas su snabs za na rnams dang*/ zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang | zas su skyugs pa za ba rnams dang*/ zas su stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang*/ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ ) drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang | gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig bsrung ba lnga'i cho ga 'di bsgrub par bya'o/ /spos dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /gtor ma dang mchod pa 'dis mgu bar gyis la/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la/ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang | gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ gzi byin 'phrog pa'i gdon rnams ∶ dang (《 zha 》《 lu 》 dengs shig ) 'byung po (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ dang gnod sbyin ) gang su dag zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ dge ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa rnams bdag la nyon ciga'adi lta ste/ nag mo bzhin sgyur ma/ grul bum ma/ dung can ma/ me tog ka ma la lta bu'i mig can ma/ 'phrog ma/ skra mdog ljang gu ma/ dpal ldan ma/ spre'u ltar dmar ser ma/ 'phyang ma/ rab tu 'phyang ma/ dus kyi zhags pa can ma/ bum lto ma/ gshin rje'i pho nya ma/ 'byung po za ba ma/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ dri dang*/ gtor ma 'di 'bul gyis bzhes la/ 'jigs pa dang gnod pa thams cad las ming 'di zhes bya ba la srung du gsol/ lo brgya'i 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog cig

ming 'di zhes bya ba la rigs sngags kyi gzhi rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod nas rol mo dang bcas te gtor ma gtong ngo*/ /mtshams bcad pa ste dang po'o || || ༄༅/ /sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig rgyal ba nyid kyi gnyis med thugs las rnam sprul pa/ /sna tshogs tshul 'chang dkar ser dmar sngo margad mdog mtshungs pa/ /so sor 'brang ma stong chen rab 'joms rma bya chen mo dang*/ /gsang sngags rjes 'dzin bsil ba'i tshal la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshe dang longs spyod 'khor dang dpal dang snyan pa dang | | gzungs dang ting 'dzin bla na med pa'i ye shes sogs/ /sgrub po rnams kyis bde blag nyid du thob byed pa'i/ /sgrub thabs rim pa bla ma'i gsung bzhin bdag gis bshad/ /de la 'dir bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ dkyil 'khor 'di'am gzhan du dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ bla ma las lung yang dag par nos pa/ bsrung ba lnga bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis khrus dang gtsang sbra tshul bzhin du byas la/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la snying thag pa nas skyabs su song la/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod pa'i phyir/ rig pa'i rgyal mo rnam pa lnga bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed la/ rang gi spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du oṃ ā:hūm̐ gi yi ge dkar po dang*/

dmar po dang*/ sngon po gsum rim pa bzhin du bsams nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rakṣaḥrakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba lan gsum gyis bdag dang*/ gsum gyis gnas dang*/ gsum gyis rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i dbus su pam̐ gi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las | padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri ma med pa'i shel ltar dkar zhing gsal ba'i pram̐ gi yi ge bsams la/ de las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sgrib pa thams cad bsal nas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phyi rol du spros pas/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don byas nas/ 'od kyi snang ba de nyid kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rje btsun ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo la sogs pa'i lha mo lnga dang | bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs spyan drangs la/ phyag dang mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas ji skad bshad pa'i yan lag bdun pa byas la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can thams cad la dmigs te/ byams pa dang snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms tshad med pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i rjes la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3ham̐/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam pa ni/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams de nyid du pa~Xm̐ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa sna tshogs pa'i kha dog can gyi steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su hūm̐ gi yi ge gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dmigs te/ de las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer phyogs kun tu spros pas rab tu brtan zhing mi phyed pa/ go mtshams med pa'i rdo rje'i sa bzhi dang*/ ra ba dang*/ dra ba dang*/ gur dang | bla re dang*/ mda'i dra ba dang*/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom par bya'o/

/de'i dbus su sum̐ gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍūrya/ nub padma rā ga byang gser las grub pa/ bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ steng du rin po che'i lcog brgyad kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs padma la gnas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bhrūm̐ gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las ye shes rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po las dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du mda' yab dang*/ pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ phyi 'dod yon gyi snam bu la lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rin po che'i gdung bzhis (《 lu 》 phub 《 zha 》 - bzhis ) phyur bur phubs pa'i steng na rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor rta babs ka ba bzhis bteg pa'i bang rim bzhi ba'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ gdugs dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang 'phan dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ lda ldi dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa du mas 'dzes par brgyan par bsam mo/ /de'i nang du pam̐ las chu skyes 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar du bcas pa bskyed la de'i dbus dang*/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi dang lngar padma 'dab ma brgyad pa lnga bsgoms nas/ shar phyogs kyi padma'i steng du nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ gzhan rnams su zla ba'i gdan re re bsam mo/ /de dag ni rten bskyed pa'o/ /de nas brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du pram̐ dkar po/ shar dang*/ lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang rnams su hūm̐ dang*/ mam̐ dang*/ sham̐ dang*/ gam̐ gi yi ge sngon po dang*/ ser po dang | dmar po dang*/ ljang gu rnams bsams la/ de rnams las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros pas/

nam mkha'i mthas btugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par byas nas slar 'dus te/ sa bon so so la thim pas rkyen byas nas/ chos kyi yi ge de dag yongs su gyur pa las 'chad par 'gyur ba'i lha mo lnga po cig char bskyed la/ rim gyis gsal gdab par bya'o/ /de yang dbus su rje btsun ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo gangs ri'i phung po ltar rab tu dkar ba lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas gnag pa/ rgyab ser ba/ g.yon dmar ba zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na/ 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ mda' dang*/ ral gri/ g.yon gyi phyag bzhi na/ rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ rtse gsum pa dang*/ gzhu dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ spyi bor mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab yol can/ lo ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu du mas spud pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs par bsam par bya'o/ /shar du stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang pa'i rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma rtsa ba'i zhal sngo ba/ g.yas dkar ba/ rgyab ser ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re zhing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal la la ni mche ba gtsigs shing*/ la la ni rab tu gdang nas ljags 'dril ba/ smin ma'i dbus na khro gnyer bsdus pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin pa dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ mda' dang | ral gri/ g.yon gyi phyag bzhi na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ dgra sta dang*/ gzhu dang*/ padma'i steng na rin po che zur drug pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/

rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa dang*/ rin po che dang*/ sbrul gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa | stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ rab tu khros pa/ drag mo'i tshul can/ tā la'i sdong po rab tu rgyas pa'i shing drung na/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs par bsam mo// lhor rma bya chen mo gser gyi mdog can/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser ba/ g.yas gnag pa/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas kyi phyag bzhi na mchog sbyin dang*/ rin po che'i rgyun 'bab pa'i bum pa dang*/ 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gyi phyag bzhi na/ lhung bzed kyi steng na dge slong gnas pa dang*/ rma bya'i 'jug sgro dang*/ bum pa'i steng na sna tshogs rdo rje gnas pa dang*/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ mya ngan med pa'i shing drung na bzhugs par bsam mo | | nub tu gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma/ padma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu dar la bab pa/ zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas gnag pa/ g.yon dkar ba | zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yas kyi phyag lhag ma bzhi na mchog sbyin dang*/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ mda'/ g.yon gyi phyag lhag ma bzhi na sdigs mdzub zhags pa dang bcas pa dang*/ padmas brgyan pa'i bum pa dang*/ rin po che'i snye ma dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol la brten pa/ shi ri sha'i shing drung na bzhugs par bsam mo/

/byang du bsil ba'i tshal chen mo/ ma ra ka ta ltar ljang ba/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ljang ba/ g.yas dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas kyi phyag gsum na mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ rdo rje dang | mda'/ g.yon gyi phyag gsum na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs pa/ nyi ma'i rgyal yol can | tsam pa ka'i shing drung na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /'og gzhi padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir ye shes kyi bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa bzhi bsam par bya'o/ /de ltar ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi lha mo lnga'i sku rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal bar dmigs nas/ de dag gi dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga'i gnas su yi ge gsum dang*/ snying gi nang du padma dang zla ba la gnas pa so so'i kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i sa bon gyi yi ge bsams nas/ de dag las rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i sras dang 'khor du bcas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pas yongs su bskor ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la/ me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod nas/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas dam tshig pa dang*/ ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas yang yi ge de dag las sngar bstan pa'i tshul gyis 'od zer du ma spros pas dbang bskur gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mngon par mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas

| sangs rgyas de rnams kyis (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing ) ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas lha thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ sngags dang | phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs la dbang bar du byas nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs kyi bdag po (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ lha mo lnga la ) rdo rje sems dpa' lngas (《 zha 》+ dang gzhan thams cad la phyag na rdo rjes ) dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de ltar lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan nam/ dbang po'i gzhu lta bu de nyid la yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su shes pa 'phro bar gyur na sngags kyi bzlas pa la 'jug par bya ste/ de yang so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mtha' mar so so'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor zhing*/ phreng ba de dag las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ las so so bsgrub pa la dmigs nas las dang rjes su 'brel pa'i phreng ba 'dz-in pas/ gsang sngags 'di dag bzla bar bya'o/ /de'ang oṃ ma ṇi nghā ri badzrī ni ma hā pra ti sī re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rje btsun so sor 'brang ma chen mo'i'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta ba re wa ra wa ra pra wa ra bi shungnghe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma'i'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo kī ni garbha sam̐ rakṣa ni ā karṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rma bya chen mo'i'o/ /oṃ bi ma le bi pū le dza ya wa re a mṛ te bi ra dze hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i'o/ /oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra ind+rā ya ∶ ba (《 zha 》 bha bha ) la bi sho ngha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ru ru tsa le swā hā/

bsil ba'i tshal chen mo'i'o/ /ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor de dag la dngos su 'byor pa'am/ ma 'byor na yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pas mchod nas mngon par bstod de/ oṃ badzra twa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha ba/ a nurakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba singnghi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karm+ma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wā na/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ma me muñtsa badzrī bha wa/ ma hā sa ya ma sa twa a/ zhes gsum mam bdun brjod pas cho ga lhag chad kha bskangs nas | ye shes pa rang las phye nas mdun na gnas pa la mchod cing bstod nas gsol ba gdab pa tshul bzhin du byas la bzod par gsol te smon lam rgya chen po btab nas/ oṃ badzra mu:zhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol lo | | rang gi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrungs nas/ ci bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /de dag gis ni mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa bstan zin to | | rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa'i phyir cho ga'i rim pa las kyi yan lag du ma dang bcas pa ni kho bos gzhan du ston par 'gyur bas der shes par bya'o/ /'di yi gzungs rnams bya ba'i rgyud kyi khongs su 'du zhing de dag gi | sna tshogs cho ga'i las kyi rim pa so sor gnas mod de lta 'ang*/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag rim pas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ / lha mo rnam lnga bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs kho bos deng 'dir bstan zin to/ / dge ba gang zhig nam mkha'i ngos ltar rgya cher yangs pa gang bskrun pas/ / sdug bsngal rba klong rnam par 'khrugs pa'i srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba kun// rab tu bsgral nas yon tan nor bus rnam par bkra ba thar pa yi/ /gling mchog dam par stobs bcu'i stobs ldan bsnyengs bral mchog la 'god par shog
